requirements.description: User wants the property located near green spaces. Expressed as a proximity preference, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user wants a building in energy class D or better. This covers A1-A4, B, C and D. The Turin location and proximity to green spaces are geographic and out of scope, so they are not translated into filters. No size, capacity or structural requirements were stated, so none are added.
